newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA, SLOVAKIA IN WOMEN'S FINAL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA, SLOVAKIA IN WOMEN'S FINAL.

text.p: Slovakia and Lithuania will dispute the European women's basketball championship on Sunday while their Saturday Hungary and Germany will try to grab the third position.
Slovakia beat Hungary 81 to 55 showing superior skills both in defence and attack against a seemingly tired Hungarian team.
The Slovak team had a quick start marking its first point in the 10th second and by the middle of the first half their advantage increased to 10 points.

The more dinamic and inventive Slovaks managed to keep a comfortable cushion of 8 to 12 points throughout the first half and also took advantage of uninspired Hungarian attacks stealing the ball several times.
Kotocova, Hirakova and Bielikova's aim was almost faultless regardless of distance.
After a time-out asked by Hungary's coach Laszlo Killik his team changed tactics but the Slovaks quickly regrouped accordingly and went on to finish the first half 9 point ahead at 37-28.

The Hungarian ladies were no match for the Slovaks in the second half either and Slovakia hammered home a 81-55 win, prompting at least half the 8,000 spectators in Budapest's biggest sports hall to head for their cars without waiting for the other semifinal, in which Lithuania beat Germany by a single point after extensions.
Lithuania was off to a powerful start and by the 15th minute it led 27-15 but the German team pulled itself together and at half-time they were only one point behind their opponents.
Both teams started the second half with very determined but somewhat disorganised play and the Germans were the ones who first recovered and by the 31st minute developed a five-points advantage.
The Lithuanian ladies gathered their forces for what they tought would be the last 10 minutes but the regular pyaling time ended with a draw of 70-70.
During the five-minute extended play the remaining 4,000 spectators witnessed a head-to-head battle which Lithuania won with Kurtinaitiene's point.
